briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Anthropic Claude 4.5 escalate frontier race as compute shortages intensify

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has entered a high-stakes phase with multiple frontier labs releasing advanced reasoning models. Funding surges past $14B this quarter while regulatory scrutiny grows over autonomous agents.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with native multi-agent orchestration; Anthropic released Claude 4.5 Sonnet achieving 92% on SWE-Bench. xAI Grok-3 and DeepSeek-R2 trail closely in benchmarks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 2M units monthly; Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100-equivalent clusters in Texas and Arizona. Energy constraints now limit further scaling.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first company to reach reliable 95% autonomous R&D capability trigger an irreversible intelligence explosion?
